name: Acceptor Configuration
definition: Acceptor parameters to be downloaded from the terminal management system.

FinancialCapture.name: Financial Capture
FinancialCapture.definition: Mode for the financial capture of the transaction by the acquirer.

BatchTransferContent.name: Batch Transfer Content
BatchTransferContent.definition: Types of transaction to include in the batch.

MaximumNumber.name: Maximum Number
MaximumNumber.definition: Maximum number of transactions without exchange.

MaximumAmount.name: Maximum Amount
MaximumAmount.definition: Maximum cumulative amount of the transactions without exchange.

ReconciliationByAcquirer.name: Reconciliation By Acquirer
ReconciliationByAcquirer.definition: Indicates the reconciliation period is assigned by the acquirer instead of the acceptor.

TotalsPerCurrency.name: Totals Per Currency
TotalsPerCurrency.definition: Indicates the reconciliation total amounts are computed per currency.

ProtectCardData.name: Protect Card Data
ProtectCardData.definition: Indicator to require protection of sensitive card data in messages.

RetailerParameters.name: Retailer Parameters
RetailerParameters.definition: Acceptor parameters dedicated to the retailer.

ApplicationParameters.name: Application Parameters
ApplicationParameters.definition: Configuration parameters attached to the payment application.

TerminalManagementSystem.name: Terminal Management System
TerminalManagementSystem.definition: Terminal management system for which an acceptor configuration is provided.
